mapper.select: SELECT "PUSH_NO", "RECEIVER_NO", "SENDER_NO", "PUSH_TYPE", "PUSH_MSG", "IS_READ", "PUSH_DATE", "FEED_NO" , S."USER_NICKNAME" AS "SENDER_NICKNAME" , UI."FILE_NAME" AS "SENDER_PROFILE_FILE_NAME" FROM "PUSH" P LEFT JOIN "USER" S ON P."SENDER_NO" = S."USER_NO" LEFT JOIN "USER_IMG" UI ON S."USER_NO" = UI."USER_NO" WHERE P."RECEIVER_NO" = #{receiverNo} ORDER BY P."PUSH_DATE" DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "PUSH" WHERE "RECEIVER_NO" = #{receiverNo} AND "IS_READ" = false

SELECT P."PUSH_NO", P."RECEIVER_NO", P."SENDER_NO", P."PUSH_TYPE", P."PUSH_MSG", P."IS_READ", P."PUSH_DATE", P."FEED_NO", S."USER_NICKNAME" AS "SENDER_NICKNAME", UI."FILE_NAME" AS "SENDER_PROFILE_FILE_NAME" FROM "PUSH" P LEFT JOIN "USER" S ON P."SENDER_NO" = S."USER_NO" LEFT JOIN "USER_IMG" UI ON S."USER_NO" = UI."USER_NO" WHERE P."RECEIVER_NO" = #{receiverNo} ORDER BY P."PUSH_DATE" DESC

SELECT P."PUSH_NO", P."RECEIVER_NO", P."SENDER_NO", P."PUSH_TYPE", P."PUSH_MSG", P."IS_READ", P."PUSH_DATE", P."FEED_NO", S."USER_NICKNAME" AS "SENDER_NICKNAME", UI."FILE_NAME" AS "SENDER_PROFILE_FILE_NAME" FROM "PUSH" P LEFT JOIN "USER" S ON P."SENDER_NO" = S."USER_NO" LEFT JOIN "USER_IMG" UI ON S."USER_NO" = UI."USER_NO" WHERE P."RECEIVER_NO" = #{userNo} ORDER BY P."PUSH_DATE" DESC LIMIT #{perPage} OFFSET #{startNum}
